headline: M2: 100-case context-sufficiency review is ready.
detail: Historical-context evidence is materialized and integrity-validated for all 100 suitable benchmark observations. The private evidence library contains 820 unique historical records supporting 1,952 case-to-context relationships; all 820 evidence hashes passed, two legacy non-UTF-8 records were preserved byte-for-byte, and relationship ground truth remains unassigned. The Excel-native review builder is now checked in and the next operator gate is human context-sufficiency review across all 100 cases.
next_gate: Complete all 100 human context-sufficiency decisions in the Excel-native review workbook. Cases marked MORE_CONTEXT_REQUIRED receive bounded retrieval expansion; cases marked SUFFICIENT_FOR_ADJUDICATION proceed to relationship ground-truth adjudication.
public_private_boundary: Only aggregate research-progress counts are public. Private evidence packets, historical-context evidence, raw operational records, and case-level decisions are not exposed by this status artifact.
